articles.title: At 39, Djokovic Wins First Match Since Wimbledon Despite Shoulder Treatment
articles.summary: Novak Djokovic beat Nuno Borges 6-3, 7-6 (7-2) at the China Open for his first win since the Wimbledon semi-finals in July and his 30th straight victory in Beijing. He needed a medical timeout for his right shoulder.

articles.title: About 20,000 People, One 3.1-Mile Table and a New World Record in Romania
articles.summary: About 20,000 people ate at a 3.1-mile table made from recycled materials in Bucharest, Romania, setting a Guinness World Record. The meal raised more than $110,000 for the country's first psychiatric hospital for children.

articles.title: NASA Announces $20 Billion "Ignition" Plan for a Permanent Moon Base
articles.summary: NASA announced "Ignition," a $20 billion plan for a permanent Moon base near the lunar south pole. Robotic missions start in 2026, and a permanent outpost phase begins in 2032.
